arStrings.szText:
When your Bone Golem takes damage, it unleashes bone spikes dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE}{/c} damage. This effect can occur once every {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} seconds.  

Enemies damaged by Bone Golem are made {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} seconds.
